text:
maria: Heads-up: onboarding firefly-6b (6.2B) from upstream. Need quick license check before we start quant runs.

zach: Model card looks OK but license has a weird clause: 'non-commercial for redistribution' — pasting snippet below.

anya-legal: Can you paste the exact clause? non-commercial could block hosted API usage.

maria: ```
LICENSE - excerpt
Section 2.b Redistribution: Allowed for 'research and personal use only'. Commercial deployment prohibited without separate consent.
Attribution required in product docs: 'Model: Firefly-6B (Upstream)'.
```

anya-legal: That looks like a CC-BY-NC style restriction + explicit attribution. Problematic for our hosted paid API and Dedicated contracts.

sam-infra: If we only offer this in Dedicated/Private (customer-managed), could that avoid the "redistribution" problem? Hosted would definitely be risky.

eva-ml: We already ran an initial FP16->4-bit quant prep sweep. Do transformations (quantization/weight packing) create a "derived" work under that wording? Upstream text is ambiguous about "derivative weights."

anya-legal: Good question. Many NC-style licenses treat distribution of modified weights as redistribution; quantized weights are likely considered a derivative. Serving via API is also commercial use if customers pay. We should not assume it's allowed.

zach: Could Sales negotiate a separate commercial license? That would be a path forward for customers who want it hosted.

maria: :thumbsup: Immediate ask for legal: confirm whether serving via API (paid calls) counts as "commercial redistribution" under this license. If yes, block adding to public model catalog and default hosted routes.

anya-legal: Short answer: likely yes. I'll escalate to upstream counsel and ask two things: (1) written clarification on whether inference-only hosting is allowed, (2) whether transformed/quantized weights are allowed to be redistributed or used commercially. Meanwhile, do not include firefly-6b in the public hosted catalog.

license-bot: NOTE: model 'firefly-6b' flagged: license=UPSTREAM-CUSTOM-NC, tag=blocked-hosted

eva-ml: Quick eval note: quantized 4-bit run shows ~2.4% drop on our NLU regression suite vs our baseline. If we can't offer hosted, Dedicated customers might still request it for cost/latency reasons. We should attach quality vs cost artifacts to the legal ticket.

maria: Agreed. Pausing the full quant sweep. I'll open a tracker ticket: "firefly-6b legal/quant hold" and attach the current eval artifacts. @zach can you add the benchmark logs?

zach: On it. uploading logs + scorer outputs to the ticket now (run ids included).

anya-legal: I'll draft an outreach email to upstream requesting commercial licensing terms and explicit language about derivative weights and inference. If they insist on NC, we can explore options (enterprise-only negotiated license, or training an adapter/LLM head ourselves), but both have drawbacks.

sam-infra: FYI, Dedicated onboarding checklist requires license clearance for redistribution. Marking dedicated flow as PENDING until legal confirms.

maria: :wave: Thanks all — keeping thread for updates. Will move artifacts into the ticket and ping when upstream responds.
